fields.name: subtitle
fields.text: Choose a stack. Flip any card to see what makes it work.

buttons.name: Haunted House
buttons.sentence: Clicking this opens the Haunted House stack.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  go to stack "Haunted House"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Graveyard
buttons.sentence: Clicking this says the Graveyard is not ready yet.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  answer "The Graveyard is still being summoned..."
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Witch's Kitchen
buttons.sentence: Clicking this says the Witch's Kitchen is not ready yet.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  answer "The Witch's Kitchen is still being summoned..."
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Pumpkin Patch
buttons.sentence: Clicking this says the Pumpkin Patch is not ready yet.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  answer "The Pumpkin Patch is still being summoned..."
end mouseUp

buttons.name: New Stack
buttons.sentence: Clicking this tells you what is coming.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  answer "Soon you will describe a card in one sentence, and it will grow here."
end mouseUp

cards.name: Gate
cards.script:
on openCard
  put "The old gate creaks in the wind." into field "sign"
end openCard

fields.name: sign
fields.text: The old gate creaks in the wind.

buttons.name: Ring the bell
buttons.sentence: Clicking this rings the bell and asks who is there. If it is a ghost, a werewolf howls back.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  answer "Ding dong! Who's there?" with "A ghost" or "Nobody"
  if it is "A ghost" then
    howl
    put "Something howled back." into field "sign"
  else
    put "Nobody answered." into field "sign"
    put " Or did they?" after field "sign"
  end if
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Enter
buttons.sentence: Clicking this opens the gate and goes to the next card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect iris open
  go to next card
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Home
buttons.sentence: Clicking this goes back to the Home stack.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  go to stack "Home"
end mouseUp

fields.name: greeting
fields.text: A candle flickers in the hall.

fields.name: note
fields.text: Something fluttered out of the closet!

buttons.name: Light a candle
buttons.sentence: Clicking this asks your name and writes a welcome for you.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  global visitor
  ask "What is your name, visitor?"
  put it into visitor
  put "Welcome," && visitor & "." into field "greeting"
  if visitor contains "Kiro" then answer "Oh! A friend of the house."
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Open the closet
buttons.sentence: Clicking this lets a bat out of the closet and shows a note for two seconds.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  release bat
  show field "note"
  wait 2 seconds
  hide field "note"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Upstairs
buttons.sentence: Clicking this wipes to the card named Attic.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect wipe left
  go to card "Attic"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Go deeper
buttons.sentence: Clicking this goes to the next card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card 1
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Back
buttons.sentence: Clicking this wipes back to the previous card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect wipe right
  go to prev card
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Count a candle
buttons.sentence: Clicking this counts one more candle. On the fourth and fifth, a witch flies by.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  put field "count" + 1 into field "count"
  if field "count" > 3 and field "count" < 6 then summon witch
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Look up
buttons.sentence: Clicking this drops a spider and makes the label shriek.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  drop spider
  put "Eek! " before field "label"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Down
buttons.sentence: Clicking this wipes back to the previous card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect wipe right
  go to prev card
end mouseUp

buttons.name: To the garden
buttons.sentence: Clicking this dissolves to the last card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect dissolve
  go to last card
end mouseUp

cards.name: Garden
cards.script:
on openCard
  hide button "Dig"
  wait 1 second
  put "The moon is out. Something is watching." into field "msg"
end openCard

fields.name: msg
fields.text: The moon is out. The garden is quiet.

buttons.name: Look at the moon
buttons.sentence: Clicking this makes something glint in the soil and shows the Dig button.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  if not (field "msg" contains "glint") then
    put "Something glints in the soil." into field "msg"
    show button "Dig"
  end if
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Dig
buttons.sentence: Clicking this digs up a seed and asks what to do with it.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  answer "You found a pumpkin seed!" with "Keep it" or "Plant it"
  put "You chose: " & it into field "msg"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Back
buttons.sentence: Clicking this goes to the previous card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  go to prev card
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Start over
buttons.sentence: Clicking this closes with an iris and goes to the first card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect iris close
  go to first card
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Home
buttons.sentence: Clicking this goes back to the Home stack.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  go to stack "Home"
end mouseUp
